title: Relational Composition as Parallel Transport: What Per-Entity Frames Force in Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.34945v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A dot product means something only when both vectors share a coordinate system. Content words have one; a fresh entity does not: rotating its coordinates alone changes nothing. We take this per-entity frame freedom as a symmetry and ask what it forces in attention. For orthogonal transports, invariant scores depend only on norms and the transported inner product $\langle x_i,T_{ij}x_j\rangle$; equivariant messages lie in the span of $x_i$ and $T_{ij}x_j$. Endpoint channel count bounds transport rank, so with one vector per entity relations must be supplied; standard attention is the flat sector of a shared frame. Representation theory attaches an integer to each mechanism; the readout decides which. With orthogonal transitions, a convex-cell readout composes a finite group exactly only at or above its smallest faithful real representation dimension. At this minimum, exactness forces a faithful representation. An even readout can decode

translated_title: 关系复合即平行移动：逐实体标架在注意力机制中强制了什么
translated_abstract: 点积只有在两个向量共享同一坐标系时才有意义。内容词拥有坐标系，而一个新出现的实体则没有：仅仅旋转其坐标不会带来任何改变。我们将这种逐实体的标架自由视为一种对称性，并追问它在注意力机制中强制了什么。对于正交输运，不变的注意力得分只能依赖于范数以及被输运的内积 $\langle x_i,T_{ij}x_j\rangle$；等变消息则落在 $x_i$ 与 $T_{ij}x_j$ 张成的空间中。端点的通道数限制了输运的秩，因此当每个实体只有一个向量时，必须额外提供关系；标准注意力正是共享标架下的平坦扇区。表示论为每个机制附加一个整数，而读出层决定最终选择哪一个。在正交转移下，凸胞读出只有在其最小忠实实表示维数处或以上才能精确复合一个有限群；在这个最小值上，精确性强制要求该表示是忠实的。一个偶读出可以解码
tldr: 本文把“每个实体拥有任意局部坐标系”视为一种对称性，从数学上推导出该约束对注意力机制中得分、消息与读出形式的强制结果，并证明标准注意力只是共享标架的平坦特例，而要精确复合一个有限群，每个实体的通道数必须不低于该群最小忠实实表示的维数。
en_tdlr: Treating each entity's arbitrary local coordinate frame as a symmetry, the paper derives what attention's invariant scores, equivariant messages, and readouts are forced to look like, showing that standard attention is merely the flat shared-frame special case and that exactly composing a finite group requires per-entity channel dimensions at least equal to the group's smallest faithful real representation.
